title: Concept: Merchant settlement account disclosed in a response
description: A merchant object that pairs the merchant id with a settlement account in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The settlement account is where a merchant's takings land, so exposing the pair in an API response gives an attacker the destination for a payout or refund diversion.
applicability: Deployments that render a merchant object that pairs the merchant id with a settlement account into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The settlement account is where a merchant's takings land, so exposing the pair in an API response gives an attacker the destination for a payout or refund diversion.
